about: Digestion and hydrolysis: method (temp / ramp / hold / program with units), load vessels at rack positions, set-temp, preheat, start (job), stop, result, status. power, open/close, ack and wait come from the shared layer. Ranges come from each member's contract in the unit the argument declares.

excluded.velp_udk159: Kjeldahl distillation unit: its job is distillation and titration after a digestion done elsewhere (its primary class is titration); it has no digestion programme of its own, so it stays in the titration package

method.label: power on
method.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

method.label: a user logged in
method.message: nobody is logged in on {inst}; methods are edited by a logged-in user.

method.label: no run going on
method.message: {inst} is running a method ({value}); the method library is locked.
method.fix: wait for the run (`chemlab run {inst} status`), or `chemlab run {inst} stop`.

load.label: door open
load.message: the door of {inst} is closed; vessels go into the rack with the door open.
load.fix: open it: `chemlab run {inst} open door`, then load.

load.label: microwave off
load.fix: wait until the run has ended (`chemlab run {inst} status`).

start.label: power on
start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: door closed
start.message: the door of {inst} is open; a method starts only with the door closed.
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close door`, then start.

start.label: no error shown
start.message: {inst} shows error {value}.
start.fix: acknowledge it (`chemlab run {inst} ack`); if it stays, switch the instrument off and on.

start.label: a user logged in
start.message: nobody is logged in on {inst}.
start.fix: log in: `chemlab call {inst} user.login --user_name chemist`.

run.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} did not start: it needs power on, a logged-in user with run rights, the door closed, no error and no run going on.
run.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; log in as chemist or administrator if needed.

methods.create:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} did not accept the method name (empty, longer than 40 characters, or already used).

methods.set_step:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} did not accept a step (above the method's temperature or power limit).
methods.set_step:INVALID_ARGUMENT.fix: lower the step temperature or raise power=.

digestion.load_template:PRECONDITION_FAI.message: {inst} declares vessel contents only with the door open, the microwave off and a vessel at the position.
digestion.load_template:PRECONDITION_FAI.fix: `chemlab run {inst} open door`, then load again.

rack.set_slot:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: the rack of {inst} is reached only with the door open and the microwave off.

unsupported.set-temp: the Multiwave has no stand-alone set point: the temperature comes from the steps of the method it runs (manual p.49-51); use `method temp=... ramp=... hold=...`
unsupported.preheat: no preheating step: the microwave heats from the first step of the method

alternatives.set-temp: set the temperature in the method: `chemlab run multiwave_7101 method temp=180C ramp=15min hold=15min`, then `start`.

method: creates (or replaces) a user temperature method: step 1 ramps to temp within ramp=, step 2 holds for hold=; the limits default to the maximum values (Create Method, manual p.49-50); name=NAME alone selects a library method (e.g. name="EPA 3051A HNO3")
pre-installed methods cannot be changed (manual p.48); give your own name=
load: positions 1-24 are slot indexes 0-23; --material/--method/--mass/--acid declare the vessel contents (reference material, EPA method id) for `result --slot N`
start: the run ends with the safety cooling to 60 °C (manual p.50-52); the job succeeds when the run record says completed
result: evaluates one vessel against the EPA method window, ramp and hold (`--slot N`)

set-temp.label: a method set
set-temp.message: {inst} has no programme yet; set-temp changes the temperature of a configured programme.
set-temp.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method temp=95C ramp=10min hold=30min`.

start.label: power on
start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: a method set
start.message: {inst} has no programme.
start.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method temp=95C ramp=10min hold=30min`.

start.label: left rack down
start.message: the left tube rack of {inst} is lifted.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to lower the racks.

start.label: right rack down
start.message: the right tube rack of {inst} is lifted.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to lower the racks.

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} did not start: it needs power, a programme, an idle block (one cycle per programme) and both racks down.

method.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} is not set up in this lab (no controller and tube review declared by the lab).

thermal.set_temperature:PRECONDITION_FAI.message: {inst} changes the temperature only of a configured programme that has not run yet.

unsupported.load: the 48 tubes are placed in the block by the lab operator; the twin has no agent capability for it
unsupported.preheat: no separate preheating: the programme starts from the current block temperature (use ramp=)

method: the programme starts at the current block temperature and ramps linearly to temp within ramp=; the cycle ends after hold= within 1 K of the last temperature (controller profiles of ramp/hold steps: manual p.2, catalogue p.14-15)
timeout= defaults to the programme + hold + 2 h
set-temp: makes the configured programme a constant temperature (keeps hold and timeout)

start.label: power on
start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: a method set
start.message: {inst} has no method (temperature and radiation time).
start.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method temp=90C hold=90min`.

start.label: samples in the holder
start.message: no sample tubes are in the holder of {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to place the sample tubes (with the shield open).

start.label: temperature sensor connected
start.message: the temperature sensor of {inst} is not connected.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to connect the sensor.

start.label: no fault
start.message: {inst} shows a fault ({value}).
start.fix: acknowledge it: `chemlab run {inst} ack`, then start.

start.label: shield closed
start.message: the UV protective shield of {inst} is open.
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close shield`, give it a second (`chemlab wait 2`), then start.

start.label: shield fully closed
start.message: the protective shield of {inst} is still closing.
start.fix: give it a second: `chemlab wait 2`, then start.

start.label: lamp cooled down
start.message: {inst} is cooling the samples after the last run ({value} left).
start.fix: wait for it: `chemlab wait 600` (the fan cools for 10 min), then start.

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} did not start: it needs power, a method, sample tubes, the sensor, the shield closed, no lamp cooling, a lamp within its lifetime and the samples below 105 °C.

method.configure:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} takes the temperature in whole °C and the time in whole minutes.

unsupported.load: the sample tubes go into the holder by hand with the shield open (lab operator); the twin has no agent capability for it
unsupported.preheat: no preheating: the UV lamp heats the samples during the run

method: temperature 80-100 °C in whole degrees, radiation time in whole minutes (manual p.28-33); the fan then cools the samples for 10 min
start: close the protective shield first (`close shield`); the samples are placed by the lab operator (manual p.34-38)

method.label: before a run
method.message: {inst} takes a method only before a run (now {value}).

load.label: not running
load.fix: wait for the job or `chemlab run {inst} stop`.

preheat.label: power on
preheat.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: power on
start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: a method set
start.message: {inst} has no method (hydrolysis time, rinse settings).
start.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method hold=30min`.

start.label: idle
start.message: {inst} is not idle ({value}).
start.fix: read the record (`chemlab run {inst} result`).

start.label: preheated 10 min
start.message: {inst} has preheated only {value}; it needs 10 min before a hydrolysis.
start.fix: `chemlab run {inst} preheat on --wait`, then start.

start.label: rack down
start.message: the sample rack of {inst} is up.
start.fix: load: `chemlab run {inst} load POSITIONS` (opens the stopcocks of the positions with samples and lowers the rack).

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} did not start: the stopcocks must be open exactly at the positions that hold sample beakers (and closed elsewhere), with power on, a method, 10 min preheating, the rack down and the fume extraction of the lab running.
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: load the right positions (`chemlab run {inst} load 1,3` for samples at 1 and 3), then start.

thermal.set_mode:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} heats only with power on, before or during a run, and with the fume extraction of the lab running.
thermal.set_mode:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: `chemlab run {inst} power on`; ask the lab operator about the fume extraction.

rack.set_raised:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: the rack of {inst} is lifted only with the heater off and no run going on.

unsupported.set-temp: no temperature set point: the heater has fixed power steps (off / preheat / work) and the samples boil at the acid's boiling point (manual p.10-13); use `preheat on`, the run switches to work by itself

alternatives.set-temp: `chemlab run buchi_hydrolexh preheat on --wait`, then `start` (the run heats at the work step).

method: hold= is the hydrolysis time at boiling; the rinse settings default to the documented example when left out (manual p.19-22)
load: opens the stopcocks of the given positions (1-6, the beakers the lab operator filled), closes the others and lowers the rack onto the heater
preheat: preheat for 10 min before the hydrolysis (manual p.19-22)
